sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that

findings.why: Pellice's only approval for HB-620 (APR-011) is for the Pinerolo plant (PLT-PIN). The ASL has no entry for HB-620 at Beinasco (PLT-BEI). Approval is per part, receiving plant and customer, so direct delivery to Beinasco has no current approval.

sources.quote: A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
Moving production to another site is a change of source.

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y, a Nordhavn program. Delivering to a different receiving site (Beinasco instead of Pinerolo) is a change of source under CSR-NOR-R2. Nordhavn's written approval (PPAP resubmission) is needed before the first shipment, and no document in force covers it.
